name: Go Dawgs! (University of Washington)
description: Fuselage: Husky purple, with a white stripe from the fin's root down and forward to the belly, gold behind it over the tail cone. Cheatlines: None. Tail: Gold with a purple leading edge edged in white, UW's purple block 'W'. Engines: Purple. Winglets: Gold with the 'W'. Titles: White 'Alaska' with 'HORIZON' after it under the forward windows; 'GO DAWGS!' big in gold across the windows; 'PROUD SPONSOR OF UW ATHLETICS' small under the windows ahead of the stripe. Colors hex: UW purple and gold are the university's; the paint matched by eye.

notes: Flown by Horizon (QXE) on the E175. Alaska's photo is from behind the wing, so positions along the fuselage were measured on the side-on photo of its sister jet N661QX ('Go Cougs', the same design in WSU's colors) and checked against this one's. 'PROUD SPONSOR OF UW ATHLETICS' isn't drawn. On the right, 'HORIZON' is forward of 'Alaska' (as on Horizon's standard E175s). 2026-11-28: from Alaska's press images, 'GO DAWGS!' drawn as the painted lettering (a mark: slanted gold slab capitals in a white outline, all one height; the left-side press photo's shrinking letters are its perspective, the side-on right-side photo shows them even), the fin's W moved to the middle of the gold and the winglets' small W added.

logos.description: UW's block 'W' in purple outlined in white, centered in the gold between the purple leading-edge stripe and the trailing edge, low on the fin; the same on both sides.
A small block 'W' near the root of each gold winglet.

titles.style: The 2016 Alaska wordmark in white, under the forward windows.
Horizon's name in small spaced bold capitals right after 'Alaska'.
On the right it follows 'Alaska' in reading order, forward of it.
Heavy slab capitals slanted forward about 11 degrees, in gold, each in a broad white outline, all the same height on one baseline, across the windows from ahead of the wing to the aft door.
